dispute_description: Kamat Hotels India Ltd has operated hotels, restaurants, and hospitality services under the trade name KAMAT across India for over four decades, enjoying substantial goodwill and reputation particularly in South and West India. Kamath Residency Pvt Ltd has opened a chain of budget hotels and dhabas in Karnataka and Maharashtra under the name KAMATH RESIDENCY using signage, color schemes, and menu designs deliberately similar to those associated with the Kamat brand, creating a misrepresentation to consumers that KAMATH RESIDENCY is affiliated with or an extension of Kamat Hotels. No prior contractual or business relationship exists between the parties. Kamat Hotels seeks a permanent injunction, delivery-up of infringing materials, and damages of Rs 1 crore for passing off its reputation and goodwill.
